text: {"lessons":["I sold several positions after gains, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; I should weigh each trade against my overall plan and risk.","My purchase price is a reference, not a forecast. I should not cling to losing positions just to avoid admitting a mistake, or sell solely to lock in a gain.","Short-term account changes and past price moves do not predict what comes next, so I should make deliberate decisions based on current risk and diversification rather than try to time random fluctuations."]}
